LeaderboardScore.title: Leaderboard Score
LeaderboardScore.description: Classification record storing player high scores and achievements

player_key.description: Lowercase normalized unique identifier for the player

name.description: Display name chosen by the player (alphanumeric)

score.description: Total score achieved in the run (non-negative)

achieved_at.description: ISO timestamp string of when the record was achieved

RoundState.title: Round State
RoundState.description: State of the competition round and lock for the leaderboard

status.description: Current status of the round: waiting, running, paused, or finished

is_finished.description: Whether the round is finalized and positions are locked

updated_at.description: ISO timestamp string of last update

/leaderboard_scores/{playerKey}.description: Global leaderboard collection where each document ID is playerKey

/round_state/{stateId}.description: Competition round state and freeze lock
